notes: Prefill-lane screen arm: 2 lane(s) with --prefill-yield off, over the site profile. The pinned vLLM refuses prefill yield beside more than one lane (prefill_yield replaces prefill lanes, vllm/config/scheduler.py), so every lane arm, including the one-lane control, turns the yield off; the production profile keeps both at the recipe's values. The profile the arm extends is the site's ignored file, created by copying this folder's profile.json to it (see README, Commands).
